caveats: conditional, model-internal global-mean linear statistic; not an observational amplitude, not comparable with survey or CMB values without a Timescape reduction
the void share p(k) is an external closure (VOID_ONSET_RESPONSE = EXTERNAL_CLOSURE_INPUT); the value is conditional on it

linear means the formal zero-amplitude tangent (linear extrapolation) around the smooth two-phase tracker state, a proposed definition (owner decision D1, 2026-10-07); it is not the ensemble-mean response of the true region contrast and ignores the zeroth-order partition fluctuations on the region scale
when the void-volume response rms exceeds 1 the linear void response is applied beyond its declared validity (H-A8, formal extrapolation); below 1 no controlled truncation error is established either
seed-indexed void accounting H-A9: equal to the material-domain volume only with scale separation (void radius much smaller than the region radius)
regional laws A1-A5 and void autonomy H-A6 assumed; the regional embedding stays NOT_DERIVED
early spectrum is a PROVISIONAL_MODEL_IMPORT; the radius identification is CONVENTION_DEPENDENT

early_spectrum.provenance: Planck 2018 VI (arXiv:1807.06209) Table 2, TT,TE,EE+lowE+lensing; T_cmb 2.7255 K

frames.field: dust rest-mass density on the dust-orthogonal foliation
frames.linear_order: formal zero-amplitude tangent of the regional contrast map around the smooth two-phase tracker state, applied to the early Gaussian field (linear extrapolation); smoothing rule G_R(k) = G(k) W(kR); not the ensemble-mean response of the true contrast
frames.mean: global Buchert volume average on the same slice
frames.time: dust proper time t (common time), present epoch t0
frames.void_accounting: seed-indexed (H-A9): bubbles assigned to the region containing their seed; equals the material-domain volume only with scale separation

assumptions: A1-A5 (1G-C and its owner decisions): walls are Einstein-de Sitter regions in the common time t, which the wall matter clocks (A5)
H-A6 void autonomy: each empty void region expands as Milne, V_v proportional to t^3, independently of the surrounding wall density; no wall-void volume transfer (1G-G G5 with J = 0)
all matter in walls (empty voids, the tracker's rho_v = 0)
growing modes only: the wall bang-time mode t^-1 and decaying void modes are absent (regular growing-mode initial conditions)
matter-era photon normalisation at the explicit matching redshift; radiation at last scattering neglected
